name: Kitazato Corporation
summary: Kitazato Corporation researches, develops, produces and distributes medical devices and supplies for fertility treatment. Its reproductive medicine range includes needles, catheters, cannulas, vitrification media and equipment, and sperm processing media. Dating from 1998 as Kitazato Biopharma Co., Ltd., it has its headquarters in Shizuoka, Japan, and is a subsidiary of Kitasato Shoji Co., Ltd.
